{{Current events|year=2019|month=04|day=18|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflict and attacks
*[[2019 Makran massacre]]
**14 people are killed in a gun attack on a bus in [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/04/18/asia/pakistan-balochistan-bus-killings-intl/index.html (CNN)]
;Disasters and accidents
*At least 13 people are killed and 29 others are injured when a wall collapses in [[Empangeni]], [[South Africa]], at the start of an Easter service at a Pentecostal church. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-47987959 (BBC)]
*Mountain climbers [[Jess Roskelley]], [[David Lama]] and [[Hansjörg Auer]] are suspected dead after an [[avalanche]] on [[Howse Peak]] in Canada's [[Banff National Park]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-ca/news/canada/trio-of-world-renowned-climbers-missing-and-presumed-dead-in-banff-avalanche/ar-BBW4W3p?ocid=spartanntp (MSN.com)]

;Law and crime
*[[Dissident Irish Republican campaign]]
**Northern Irish journalist [[Lyra McKee]] is shot dead by [[dissident republican]]s on the [[Creggan estate]] in [[Derry]]. [https://www.irishnews.com/news/northernirelandnews/2019/04/19/news/journalist-lyra-mckee-29-shot-dead-during-derry-rioting-1601462/ (The Irish News)]
*The [[Royal Thai Navy]] is planning to remove a house that was allegedly constructed illegally {{convert|12|mi|km|2|abbr=on}} off the Thai coastline to promote [[seasteading]]. The owners had planned to start a community of at least 20 houses in the area. Thai authorities have filed a complaint, which if prosecuted could carry a death sentence for "threatening the sovereignty of a state, and erosion of a state's independence". [http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/an-american-thai-couple-are-in-deep-water-over-their-attempt-to-establish-a-community-at-sea/ar-BBW3KHd?li=BBnb7Kz (''Time'' via MSN)]
*Aftermath of the [[Bishop International Airport attack]]
**Amor Ftouhi is sentenced to life in prison for stabbing a police officer at [[Bishop International Airport]] in [[Flint, Michigan]], United States in June 2017. [https://www.mlive.com/news/flint/2019/04/flint-airport-stabber-sentenced-to-life-in-prison-says-he-doesnt-regret-actions.html (MLive)] 
;Politics and elections
*[[Special Counsel investigation (2017–2019)]], [[Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections]]
**The [[Mueller Report|redacted version of the report]] by Special Counsel [[Robert Mueller]] is released by [[United States Attorney General|U.S. Attorney General]] [[William Barr]]. The investigation did not find any conspiracy between President [[Donald Trump]] and the Russian government regarding the accusation that they collaborated to win the [[2016 United States presidential election|2016 presidential election]]. The report did not rule out if the Trump administration committed obstruction of justice. The Department of Justice also stated some members of Congress will receive a less-redacted version of the report in the near future. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/04/18/us/politics/mueller-report.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2019/04/17/mueller-report-congress-get-less-redacted-version-doj-says/3501962002/ (''USA Today'')]
